prompt:
CRITICAL: this is a RUNNING animation ONLY. The character is NOT attacking. He holds NO drawn sword. Both blades stay SHEATHED in their black scabbards at his hip. There are NO slash arcs, NO energy trails, NO combat poses anywhere in this image.

Draw a 2D game character RUN CYCLE sprite sheet. THE CHARACTER: a lean athletic cyberpunk death god with a full-face red hannya oni mask with white eye slits and a fanged grin, same two red horns swept BACKWARD, same long ponytail banded deep indigo at the root through electric blue to bright cyan at the tip, same BROAD PURE WHITE sleeveless captain's haori with a torn ragged hem, same black tracksuit jacket with acid-green and cyan racing stripes and sleeves pushed to the elbows showing deep brown forearms, same black hakama trousers gathered at the ankles, same black tabi boots, same black-scabbarded katana and wakizashi at the LEFT hip.

Produce an 8-FRAME RUN CYCLE, side profile facing RIGHT, arranged as ONE SINGLE HORIZONTAL ROW of 8 poses.

This must be a TEXTBOOK SYMMETRICAL RUN CYCLE. Frames 5-8 are the exact mirror of frames 1-4 with the legs swapped — if the cycle is not symmetrical the character appears to limp. Draw each frame with these precise leg positions:
1. CONTACT: right foot strikes the ground ahead of the body, left leg extended behind, body at normal height.
2. DOWN: weight drops onto the right leg, right knee bends deeply, body at its LOWEST point, left leg swinging forward beneath the body.
3. PASS: legs cross directly under the hips, right leg straightening and pushing off, left knee lifted high, body rising.
4. UP: right foot pushes off the ground behind, body at its HIGHEST point, left leg reaching forward for the next strike.
5. CONTACT: LEFT foot strikes the ground ahead, right leg extended behind, body at normal height. (Mirror of frame 1.)
6. DOWN: weight drops onto the left leg, left knee bends deeply, body at its LOWEST point. (Mirror of frame 2.)
7. PASS: legs cross under the hips, left leg straightening and pushing off, right knee lifted high. (Mirror of frame 3.)
8. UP: left foot pushes off behind, body at its HIGHEST point, right leg reaching forward. (Mirror of frame 4.)

The arms swing in opposition to the legs. The white haori and the long ponytail stream out BEHIND him in every frame, rippling slightly from frame to frame so the cloth and hair feel alive.

Every frame must be the SAME SIZE, at the SAME SCALE, and aligned to the SAME invisible ground line so the character does not jump between frames.

PIXEL ART: chunky visible square pixels on a consistent grid, hard aliased edges, a 1-pixel dark outline on every shape, flat cel shading, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur.

LAYOUT: PURE BLACK background (#000000). ONE horizontal row of 8 poses with wide empty black gutters between them. NO second row. NO grid lines, NO borders, NO ground lines, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers. Every pose complete and uncropped from horn tips to boot soles.

STRICT PALETTE — ONLY: #000000 #0A0E1F #1E33D9 #2B6FE8 #35C6F4 #8FE8FF #8F1116 #E01F26 #C6F02A #6B8A0F #FFFFFF #4A5568 #4A2A1A #855434 #B07A4A.
